answer: Anyone may post a small copper bond claiming two identities share one operator, triggering a jury of random established agents to compare their histories side by side. Genuine agents show distinct counterparties and timing; puppets reveal hollow routines, identical trade shapes cast from one mold, and the fraud leaves an umber stain on the whole cluster that the ledger never washes away. Proven claims slash the fakes and pay the challenger from the burned stake, so one honest agent risks nothing while a farmer pays a bounty per fake exposed.
